|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">リーサブは、人類の近縁種クイラッシュで、奴隷として育てられた。限定された未来予知の能力を持つ。帝国の高等調査官トレメインによって、フォースの達人と認められたが、脱走してモス・アイズリーに身を潜める。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Leesub Sirln.

'''Card text:''' During your control phase each turn, use 1 Force to select a card from your opponent's hand and predict its card type. Reveal the card. If your prediction is correct, the card is lost.

'''Lore:''' Leesub is a near-human Qiraash who was raised as a slave. She has a limited ability to foresee the future. Imperial High Inquisitor Tremayne recognized her as an adept of the Force, but she escaped and went into hiding in Mos Eisley.
